title: New Twitter Launches After Claiming Musk's X Abandoned the Name
summary: Operation Bluebird, a Virginia-based startup, has launched a new social media platform called Twitter.now, asserting that Elon Musk's X Corporation abandoned the 'Twitter' name and trademarks. The launch follows a tentative court ruling suggesting X may have relinquished intellectual property rights. The new platform resembles the original Twitter but includes an AI-powered fact-checking tool called Vera. Legal challenges from X Corporation are expected to continue.
key_points: Operation Bluebird launched Twitter.now, claiming X Corporation abandoned the 'Twitter' name and trademarks after rebranding.
A federal judge tentatively ruled that X may have given up rights to the 'tweet' and 'Twitter' trademarks, though no written order has been issued.
The new platform mimics the original Twitter but introduces Vera, an AI-based fact-checking tool for real-time tweet analysis.
The startup emphasizes rebuilding Twitter on trust and distancing itself from X Corporation.
Legal experts anticipate further litigation from X Corporation in response to the launch.
